assembly_info.comments:
Background:

The Leishmania tropica LRC-L590 (WHO strain identifier MHOM/IL/1990/P283) was obtained from Dr. Charles Jaffe (Israel). This strain is able to differentiate to axenic amastigotes.
Abedelmajeed Nasereddina, Carola Schweynoch, Gabriele Schonian & Charles L. Jaffe (2010), Characterization of Leishmania (Leishmania) tropica axenic amastigotes. Acta Tropica 113: 72-79.
Genomic DNA was prepared by CsCl/Ethidium bromide density gradient centrifugation to minimize the amount of kinetoplast (mitochondrial) DNA, and was provided by Drs. Natalia Akopyants and Stephen Beverley, Washington University School of Medicine.
Total sequence coverage of Illumina instrument reads was 253X (fragments, 3 and 8kb) using a genome size estimate of 35Mb. The combined sequence reads were assembled using the ALLPATHS software (Broad Institute). This draft assembly was referred to as Leishmania tropica L590 2.0.2. This version has been gap filled and cleaned of contaminating contigs. The assembly is made up of a total of 448 scaffolds with an N50 scaffold length of over 292kb (N50 contig length was 32.7kb). The assembly spans 31.3Mb.

This work was supported by NIH grant AI29646 to SMB and by NIH-NHGRI grant 5U54HG00307907 to RKW, Director of The Genome Institute at Washington University.

For questions regarding this Leishmania tropica L590 2.0.2 assembly please contact Dr. Wesley Warren, Washington University School of Medicine (wwarren@genome.wustl.edu). Downloads of the sequence data are available via the TriTrypDB genome browser server. Funding for the sequence characterization of the Leishmania tropica strain L590 genome was provided by the National Human Genome Research Institute (NHGRI), National Institutes of Health (NIH).
